'''Siturn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Siturn was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where he used the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[B9-D7]] to communicate via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to Imperial aligned individuals.<ref name="TORTFC">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|The First Casualty|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
